name: Shakuntala Gupta/ ଶକୁନ୍ତଳା ଗୁପ୍ତା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Shakuntala Gupta writes in Odia and English and has taken part in the literary activities of South Asian Poets of New England, or SAPNE. A report of its sixth annual folk and oral literature festival describes her singing an original poem shaped by the Halia songs of western Odisha’s farmers. That participation places her work in conversation with both written poetry and oral performance.

Her poems here explore the closeness of place, desire and the self. ‘ଆବରଣ’ moves from monsoon expectation into images of vulnerability and unequal power, while the English ‘I don’t find myself’ draws on flowers, trees and the language of love. In ‘ମୋ ଭିତରେ ଗାଆଁଟିଏ’, a village lives within the speaker through courtyards, cattle sheds, trees and weathered doors: memory becomes a place another person is invited to enter.
